items.title: Free global sections on an affine etale neighbourhood for a finite type module flat at a point
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, for a finite type module flat at a point of a locally finite type morphism, an affine elementary etale neighbourhood and an affine open of the base change on which the global sections of the restriction are free (statement lines 5727-5738, tag 05U7-adjacent). The proof reduces to the finite presentation case by embedding into an affine space and applying the local structure statement, then appeals to the finite presentation affine neighbourhood result and to freeness of projective modules over a local ring. The two reductions are the substance, so the claim is H2.
